mag_metrics_df <- read_excel(SUPPL_TAB2_INPUT, skip = 1)

print("--- Supp Table 1 & Supp Table 2 Data Loaded Successfully ---")

# Analysis of unique gene counts across profiling software architectures
get_unique_count <- function(df) {
  if ("clean_gene" %in% colnames(df)) {
    return(n_distinct(df$clean_gene))
  } else if ("gene" %in% colnames(df)) {
    return(n_distinct(df$gene))
  } else {
    return(nrow(df))
  }
}
